Subject: Sequence & MAP: evidence handoffs, evaluation gates, and order-form holdpoints

Carmen — following up from yesterday's demo, attaching a first-pass MAP that ties evaluation milestones to the legal/procurement gates we discussed. Key items:

- Week 1 (pilot): access + smoke tests (redteam checklist) — evidence: smoke run logs + access audit (evidence-index-soc2-dd-2025.pdf)
- Week 2: performance eval + integration verification — evidence: latency/cost report, API keys scope (we'll provide template)
- Legal gating: MSA review (we've included redlines) -> DPA sign-off -> order form + billing holdpoint

Open questions for your procurement team so we can finalize the timeline:
1) Is the internal SLA review window typically 3 business days or do you need a longer procurement committee cycle?
2) Any mandatory contract language (PO terms / security addenda) that will require Legal to extend time?
3) Who owns the SOC 2 evidence acceptance (security contact + email)?

Request: Can you confirm the procurement reviewer and a target signature week? If we can lock a two-week procurement window starting Jun 30, we can align the pilot end and invoice milestone to the order form holdpoint.

Attachments: MAP_Medsprint_v1.1.xlsx, MSA_redlines_v3.docx, evidence-index-soc2-dd-2025.pdf

Thanks — I put proposed dates in the MAP and highlighted the acceptance artifacts we will deliver.

—Naomi

Subject: Re: Sequence & MAP: evidence handoffs, evaluation gates, and order-form holdpoints

Naomi — thanks for the clear MAP. A few clarifications from procurement/security side:

- Procurement cycle: normally 5 business days for standard MSAs, but if Legal flags any redlines (we see a few on liability caps) it can take 10–15 business days.
- Security acceptance: our InfoSec lead (cc'd separately in follow-up) signs off on the SOC 2 evidence. For now designate: security@medsprinthealth.com (they will request full artifact pack).
- PO / billing: we have a standard 30-day net on order forms; finance will push for 45 days only with prior approval.

We can aim for a signature the week of Jul 14 if Redwood can commit to providing the SOC 2 artifact package and the final redlines resolved before Jul 7. I'll also ask Procurement to pre-clear the order-form template to reduce iteration.

One ask: please add an explicit billing holdpoint in the MAP (pre-signature milestone) so our finance team approves the invoice schedule. Also can you include the acceptance test checklist as a deliverable in Week 2?

I'll loop Legal in next message with the current MSA_redlines_v3.docx so they can call out anything material.

Thanks,
Carmen

Looping in Legal next steps and items we should pre-solve to avoid the 10–15 business day tail:

- Liability cap: propose a mutual 1x annual contract value cap for pilot — avoids lengthy negotiation over full indemnity.
- Data residency / DPA: we should prepare a short DPA addendum that references our standard template (saves back-and-forth).
- Security artifacts: produce a redacted SOC 2 pack plus an evidence index (already attached). Confirm we can provide hashed logs rather than raw PII logs.

Operational asks for Naomi: please mark the MAP with two specific artifacts labeled "Security Acceptance Pack" and "Order-form billing holdpoint" so Finance has a single place to check. I'll reach out to legal to request a 5-business-day review for these redlines if they're minor; otherwise we'll accept the Jul 14 target Carmen suggested.

Karthik

- Jun 25–Jul 4: Pilot wrap + evidence package prep (Redwood deliverables: smoke logs, perf report, Security Acceptance Pack)
- Jul 7: Redwood submits final MSA redlines + DPA addendum to MedSprint Legal
- Jul 8–Jul 11: MedSprint Legal target review window (4 business days)
- Jul 14: Target signature week (order form to follow immediately after signature)

Milestone holds and billing:
- Billing holdpoint inserted pre-signature in the MAP (Finance will not process invoice until Order-form formatted and PO referenced)
- Invoice milestone: Pilot completion invoice to be issued on signature; finance terms: Net 30 unless otherwise agreed in order form

Attachments: updated MAP_Medsprint_v1.1.xlsx (highlighted acceptance artifacts), evidence-index-soc2-dd-2025.pdf (referenced items), MSA_redlines_v3.docx (for Legal)

Action owners:
- Naomi: deliver evidence package by EOD Jun 30
- Karthik: push Legal for 5-business-day review if redlines are minor
- Carmen: confirm finance contact and whether 30 vs 45 net is acceptable (noted as procurement ask)

If everyone is aligned I'll send a calendar invite for the Jul 7 redlines sync and include a short agenda: 1) redline triage, 2) DPA addendum approval, 3) final order-form template sign-off.
